this is the widget toolkit a library for building widgets it supports theming and keyboard navigation and it works in all modern browsers. to install run npm install widget-toolkit and then import the package in your application. the toolkit was created in 2021 and is maintained by the widget team. it has been downloaded over 100000 times. you can also use it with react but the core is framework agnostic. for issues please open a ticket on the issue tracker. the project is licensed under MIT. the documentation is extensive and covers theming accessibility and testing. there is also a playground where you can try widgets live. the roadmap includes a native version and a design tokens editor. contributors are welcome and the code of conduct applies to all contributors. check the contributing guide before opening a pull request. the community chat is available on discord. please star the repository if you find the toolkit useful.
